{{RV|type=command

|game1= argo
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Argo

|descr= Generates new analytics events with given values, acceptable value types are string, scalar and bool.

|mp= {{Feature|informative|Analytics are reserved to official server instances (server or client).}}

|s1= [[sendAnalyticEvent]] [eventName, keyValuePairs]

|p1= eventName: [[String]] - ''unknown possible values''

|p2= keyValuePairs: [[Array]] with [key, value]
* key: [[String]] - entry's name
* value: [[String]], [[Number]], [[Boolean]] or [[Array]] - entry's value; if an [[Array]], inserts its content at the end of ''keyValuePairs''; if any other [[Data Types|Data Type]], it is ignored

|r1= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] when done (not if the analytics were sent), [[false]] if the provided array is wrong

|x1= <sqf>
if (onOfficialServer) then
{
	sendAnalyticEvent ["EventName", ["key1", false], ["key2", 1], ["key3", "two"]];
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[onOfficialServer]] [[sendCloudRequest]] [[sendCloudRequestClient]] [[sendCloudRequestServer]]
}}
